title: IAF Recruitment 2027 – Agniveervayu Intake 02/2027
overview: The Indian Air Force invites applications for the Agniveervayu Intake 02/2027 for unmarried male and female candidates. The recruitment process involves an online test, physical fitness test, and medical examination for a 4-year engagement period. Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary package and a terminal Seva Nidhi benefit upon completion of service.
description:
Post Name(s)

Agniveervayu (Intake 02/2027)

Vacancy Details

The document does not specify the total number of vacancies. Vacancies are allocated state-wise and will be used for the preparation of the Provisional Select List (PSL).

Pay Scale

  • 1st Year: ₹30,000/- per month
  • 2nd Year: ₹33,000/- per month
  • 3rd Year: ₹36,500/- per month
  • 4th Year: ₹40,000/- per month
  • Additional Benefits: Risk and Hardship allowances, Dress and Travel allowances, Ration, Clothing, Accommodation, and Leave Travel Concession (LTC).
  • Terminal Benefit: 'Seva Nidhi' package of approximately ₹10.04 Lakhs (including interest) upon completion of 4 years.

Educational Qualification

  • Science Subjects: Passed Intermediate/10+2/Equivalent with Mathematics, Physics, and English with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English; OR Passed 3-year Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Automobile/Computer Science/Instrumentation Technology/IT) with 50% marks in aggregate and 50% in English; OR Passed 2-year Vocational Course with non-vocational subjects (Physics and Mathematics) with 50% marks in aggregate and 50% in English.
  • Other than Science Subjects: Passed Intermediate/10+2/Equivalent in any stream with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English; OR Passed 2-year Vocational Course with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% in English.

Age Limit

  • Date of Birth: Candidates born between 01 July 2005 and 01 January 2010 (both dates inclusive).
  • Upper Age Limit: 22 years as on the date of enrolment.

Application Fee

Total Fee: ₹550/- plus 18% GST (Non-refundable).

Selection Process

  1. Phase-I: Online Test (Objective Type).
  2. Phase-II: Physical Fitness Test (PFT), Adaptability Test-I, and Adaptability Test-II.
  3. Phase-III: Medical Examination.

Exam Pattern

  • Science Subjects: 60 minutes duration; comprises Physics, Mathematics, and English (10+2 CBSE syllabus).
  • Other than Science Subjects: 45 minutes duration; comprises English (10+2 CBSE syllabus) and Reasoning & General Awareness (RAGA).
  • Marking Scheme: +1 for correct answer, 0 for unattempted, -0.25 for each wrong answer.

Important Dates

Event

Date

Online Registration

06 July 2026 to 26 July 2026

Online Exam

22-23 September 2026

PSL Display

Last week of May 2027

Enrolment List Publication

After 01 June 2027

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official portal at https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in.
  2. Step-I: Register using personal and contact details to receive User-ID and password.
  3. Step-II: Log in to fill personal, communication, and qualification details.
  4. Upload required documents (Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression, etc.).
  5. Submit the application and pay the fee via the online payment gateway.
  6. Print the submitted application form for future reference.

Important Notes

  • Eligibility: Only unmarried Indian male and female candidates are eligible.
  • Marital Status: Candidates must not marry during the 4-year engagement period.
  • Tattoos: Permanent body tattoos are generally not permitted (exceptions for inner forearms/tribal customs).
  • ESM Status: Candidates are not entitled to Ex-Servicemen (ESM) status after discharge.
  • Travel Allowance: No TA/DA is admissible for any stage of the selection process.
  • Identification: Candidates must carry a valid AADHAAR card (exemptions for J&K, Ladakh, Assam, and Meghalaya).
